referenceCode:
def kth_smallest_largest(root, k):
    values = []
    stack = []
    node = root
    while stack or node:
        while node:
            stack.append(node)
            node = node.left
        node = stack.pop()
        values.append(node.val)
        node = node.right
    return [values[k - 1], values[-k]]

referenceCode:
def recover_tree(root):
    first = second = prev = None
    stack = []
    node = root
    while stack or node:
        while node:
            stack.append(node)
            node = node.left
        node = stack.pop()
        if prev and prev.val > node.val:
            if first is None:
                first = prev
            second = node
        prev = node
        node = node.right
    first.val, second.val = second.val, first.val
    return root
